mike_acme: Hey team — across multiple customers we
see function/tool-call failures when using JSON mode for structured output. Example response for one request:

mike_acme: ```
POST /v1/generate
Request ID: req_8a6f2c
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "gpt-infer-3",
  "json_mode": true,
  "function_call": {
    "name": "process_items",
    "arguments": {
      "items": "[\"sku-1\", \"sku-2\"]",
      "order_id": "ORD-123"
    }
  }
}

Response: 400 Invalid function args: 'items' expected array but got string
Error: JSON.parse failed at position 1
```

lisa_support: Can you paste the full request_id and SDK/version? Also are you using the Node SDK or curl? :thinking:

mike_acme: Request ID is req_8a6f2c, ran from customer infra using redwood-node v0.9.2. Server logs show:

mike_acme: ```
2026-02-11T15:12:03Z ERROR handler failed to call function process_items: InvalidFunctionArgs
  at parseArgs (/srv/runtime/parse.js:47)
  at handleCall (/srv/runtime/handler.js:88)
  request_id=req_8a6f2c region=us-west-2
  raw_body: {"items":"[\"sku-1\",\"sku-2\"]","order_id":"ORD-123"}
```

jon_eng: Looks like double-encoding: client stringified the array before passing as arguments. There's a known bug in the v0.9.x Node wrapper that calls JSON.stringify on arrays when building function arguments. Can you try sending raw JSON (items as array) via curl to confirm?

jon_eng: Suggested repro curl:

jon_eng: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-infer-3","json_mode":true,"function_call":{"name":"process_items","arguments":{"items":["sku-1","sku-2"],"order_id":"ORD-123"}}}'
```

mike_acme: Did that, fixed the 400s for that request pattern, but still seeing intermittent 502s and high tail latency (p95 ~ 1.8s -> 3.5s) when json_mode=true. Retries from our side caused billing to spike (we logged ~120 extra calls in 1h). Any rate-limiting or parsing retries on your side?

tara_ops: We're seeing a small bump in 5xx for /v1/generate json_mode routes in us-west-2 around that timeframe. Can you send example X-Request-ID headers from one of the 502s? Also enable `X-Debug-Mode: true` so we can get the runtime traces. Meanwhile, reduce client retry multiplier to avoid billing spiral.

mike_acme: Example 502 request header: X-Request-ID: req_8a6f2c-502b

deploy-bot: Incident opened: minor 5xx increase on json_mode paths — paging eng oncall.

jon_eng: Thanks. I'll patch the Node SDK to stop double-stringifying function args and add validation to warn at client-side. Quick hotfix: in client/lib/fncall.js replace `args[key] = JSON.stringify(val)` with `args[key] = val` (only stringify for nested strings). Will send PR shortly.

jon_eng: Also we're instrumenting a parsing fallback to return 400 with clearer message instead of 502 when parsing fails downstream.

mike_acme: Appreciate it. Can you also add a guidance doc for customers to avoid retries on parse errors? We lost revenue due to billing spike.

lisa_support: We'll escalate billing impact to finance. Next steps: Jon will PR a client patch, Ops will correlate 502s to runtime trace IDs, Support will coordinate billing credit if warranted. :thumbsup:
